title: Implement a Deep Copy Constructor
learning_objective: Implement a user-declared copy constructor that performs a deep copy of owned heap data.
instructions: Add a copy constructor to Buffer. A copied Buffer must own a separate int with the same value. Submit the complete Buffer class only; do not add main().
hints: The constructor should take const Buffer&.
Allocate a separate int instead of copying the pointer.
explanation: A deep copy duplicates the owned value into independent storage so each Buffer owns exactly one allocation.
